title: Ansys Scade One Actions documentation
text:
Ansys Scade One Actions documentation

Ansys Scade One Actions contains a collection of GitHub Actions that can be used by projects in the Ansys
Scade One ecosystem.

For information on available actions and how to use them,

title: Build Actions > FMU export
text:
FMU export

The fmu-export action builds a FMU package from a given Scade One operator.
The FMU export supports the FMI 2.0 version for Model-Exchange and Co-Simulation.

Source code for this action 









Input

Description

Required

Default

scade-dir

Scade One installation directory, e.g.
'C:\Program Files\Ansys Inc\v261\Scade One' or '/opt/AnsysInc/v261/ScadeOne/'.

True



project

Path of the Scade One project.

True



job-name

Name of the job to run. This is used to identify the job in the Scade One actions workflow.

True



kind

The FMI kind, ME for Model Exchange, CS for Co-Simulation.

False

ME

target-dir

Path to the output directory where the files are generated. If not provided, they will be
saved in the 'output/fmu_gen' directory.

False

output/fmu_gen

artifact-name

Name for the uploaded artifact. This will be used as the name for the FMU archive.

False

fmu-file

python-version

Python version used for installation and execution of the build process.

False

3.10

use-python-cache

Whether to use the Python cache to install previously downloaded
libraries.

False

pip

checkout

Whether to clone the repository on the CI/CD machine.

False

true

Limitations

Imported Type

The FMU export is not possible if imported types are used for any of the inputs or outputs
of the selected operator, or sensors in the scope of the export.

Supported Platforms

This version only supports gcc compiler on 64-bits Windows platform.
